description_en: Creates a search media library. You can use the library to store media assets
description_zh: 用户新建搜索媒资库。可以用来保存媒资
name: CreateSearchLib

parameters.help_en: The name of the search library. The name must be a combination of letters and digits. For network monitoring camera (IPC) scenarios, the prefix must be "IPCamera_". For other scenarios, you can customize the name
parameters.help_zh: 搜索库名称。数字字母组合。网络监控摄像头IPC场景前缀必须为"IPCamera_"，其他自定义即可
parameters.name: search_lib_name

parameters.help_en:
The configuration of the search library. The value is in JSON string format. Fields:
faceGroupIds: the IDs of self-registered face libraries created by calling CreateRecognitionLib. A maximum of three self-registered face library IDs are supported, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
搜索库配置。JSON string格式。其中字段
faceGroupIds ：自注册人脸库ID，来着CreateRecognitionLib创建，最多支持3个自注册人脸库根据英文","拼接
parameters.name: search_lib_config

SearchLibName.description_en: The name of the search library

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
